## Review Checklist

- [ ] Changed docs, schemas, examples, fixtures, and indexes are synchronized where applicable.
- [ ] User-visible changes are recorded in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] Compatibility and version decisions are documented; breaking changes use `docs/migration-guide.md`.
- [ ] Security, autonomy, provider neutrality, and runtime boundaries are reviewed where applicable.
- [ ] Validation results and known limits are recorded above.
- [ ] The diff contains no secrets, private data, machine-specific paths, or unrelated files.
